# FG-DEPLOY-0010

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `approving_a_deployment_twice_is_a_state_conflict` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: このデプロイは今の状態では承認できません。画面を読み込み直してください。
- en: This deployment cannot be approved in its current state. Reload the page.
- id: Deployment ini tidak dapat disetujui dalam keadaannya saat ini. Muat ulang halaman.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C11: `POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/deployments/{deployment_id}/approve` on a deployment that is not `pending_approval` (already approved and queued, running or finished). The state is read under the row's lock, so two people approving at once get one approval and one conflict. Not a fault.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `deployment_id`, `project_id` and `status` (the state found).

## 対処 (fix)

Nothing to fix: reload the deployment. To deploy again, request a new deployment.
